title: Earthy Smoky Mexican Chicken Tacos
description: A pungent and crisp Oaxacan dish featuring chicken cooked in a smoky lacquer glaze, served in a copper mug with a sprinkle of celery salt.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix together the smoked paprika, celery salt, and lacquer glaze in a small bowl.
Brush the mixture onto the chicken pieces and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush with lime juice.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing the chicken onto a warmed tortilla and topping with minced onion and chopped cilantro.
Serve the tacos in a copper mug and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Let the tacos cool for a few minutes before serving.
